constraints.name: cashier_movement_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((purpose = ANY (ARRAY['buyin'::text, 'refund'::text, 'drawer_adjustment'::text])) AND (prize_payment_id IS NULL) AND (((purpose = 'drawer_adjustment'::text) AND (method = 'cash'::text) AND (shift_id IS NOT NULL) AND (registration_id IS NULL) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NULL)) OR ((purpose = 'buyin'::text) AND (direction = 'in'::text) AND (registration_id IS NOT NULL) AND (refund_id IS NULL) AND (((method = 'cash'::text) AND (shift_id IS NOT NULL) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NULL)) OR ((method = 'bank'::text) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL) AND (shift_id IS NULL)))) OR ((purpose = 'refund'::text) AND (direction = 'out'::text) AND (registration_id IS NOT NULL) AND (refund_id IS NOT NULL) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NULL) AND (((method = 'cash'::text) AND (shift_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((method = 'bank'::text) AND (shift_id IS NULL)))))) OR ((purpose = 'prize_payout'::text) AND (prize_payment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (tournament_id IS NOT NULL) AND (method = 'cash'::text) AND (direction = 'out'::text) AND (shift_id IS NOT NULL) AND (registration_id IS NULL) AND (refund_id IS NULL) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NULL) AND (applied_amount = amount)) OR ((purpose = 'dealer_pt_wage'::text) AND (method = 'cash'::text) AND (direction = 'out'::text) AND (shift_id IS NOT NULL) AND (dealer_pt_wage_payment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (tournament_id IS NULL) AND (registration_id IS NULL) AND (refund_id IS NULL) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NULL) AND (prize_payment_id IS NULL) AND (applied_amount = amount))))
